question: The Jawaharlal Nehru Port is situated in which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Navi Mumbai.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• After Mundra Port, **Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust (JNPT) or JLN Port **or **Nhava Sheva Port**, is **India's second-largest container port.**
 
• This port on the **Arabian Sea** is situated in** Navi Mumbai's Raigad district** and is reached via Thane Creek.
 
• The port was established on** 26 May 1989.**
 
• It has a** great marine transportation **importance in our country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kandla:**

 
 
• Kandla is a **seaport **and town in the **Kutch district of Gujarat state** in Western India, close to the city of **Gandhidham.**
 
• It is one of** India's principal ports** on the west coast and is situated on the** Gulf of Kutch.**
 
• In accordance with the **Indian Ports Act of 1908**, Kandla Port was renamed **Deendayal Port in 2017.**
 
 
 
• **​Mormugao:**
 
 
• The** seaport city of Mormugao** is located in the South district's Mormugao taluka, Goa.
 
• It is still** Goa's primary port **and features a** deep natural harbor.**
 
 
 
• **Kochi:**
 
 
• Kochi is a** significant port city** on India's Malabar Coast, bordering the **Arabian Sea's Laccadive Sea.**
 
• It is known as the** "Queen of the Arabian Sea"** due to its all-weather harbor and expansive seascape.
